defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH invoiced but only 52 EACH received (GR-7724; 8 kits damaged in transit and refused at the dock)
rationale: Price matches PO exactly ($320.00/EACH, clause 3) and no UOM conversion applies. The receipt shows only 52 of 60 kits accepted, so under clause 4 the payable is computed on the received quantity: 52 × $320.00 = $16,640.00 net, plus recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% rate = $1,248.00, giving $17,888.00. The supplier's $1,440.00 tax was correct for the invoiced quantity, so this is a single defect (the shortfall), not a separate tax discrepancy — clause 11 escalation is not triggered. No credit memos outstanding; clause 10 places $17,888.00 with AP_MANAGER.
